capabilities: Reuse code block content across notes
Pass bulk anonymous variables as comma-separated values
Autocomplete template insertion from a trigger
disambiguation: Not a note-template plugin; it reuses the content of code blocks and fills in variables.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin repository, so it must be installed manually; README is in Chinese and English; reading local .csv and .json files is listed as a future step.
problem: Repeating the same code block content in many notes means copying it by hand, with no way to vary parts of it.
summary: Plugin that reuses code block content across notes, filling templates with named, anonymous and array variables.
